'''Sunny Bounder''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|racer]] and the leader of the criminal [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] the [[Black Seraphs]]. She was tall, slender, and hard-eyed.

==Biography==

Sunny Bounder had been a swoop and speeder-bike rider since her childhood, and was also involved in illegal activities such as fixing races and organizing illegal swoop races. Involved in the shady activities of criminal swoop gangs, she formed the Black Seraphs from the remains of another swoop gang whose destruction she had played a role in. Bounder and the Black Seraphs would arrange fake [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop races]] on the [[Dragonbane circuit]] to attract novice racers, whom they would rob and leave for [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="SoF" />

Her most prized possession was a [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet]] [[Flare-S swoop/Legends|Flare-S swoop]] that she and her friend [[Grinder (Corellian)|Grinder]] had heavily [[Sunflare|modified]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sunny Bounder serves as the primary antagonist, with nemesis status, in the role-playing game modular encounter scenario ''Taming the Dragon'' as part of the ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'' supplement.<ref name="SoF" />
